name: A Witch and a Ghost
source:
You, a witch elf, have noticed some strange events happening inside your house and when you use a spell, you discover a ghost in your house.

[From [url=https://fairykelly.itch.io/a-witch-and-a-ghost]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你，一个女巫精灵，注意到你的房子里发生了一些奇怪的事件，当你使用咒语时，你发现你的房子里有一个鬼魂。

[来自[url=https://fairykelly.itch.io/a-witch-and-a-ghost]itch.io[/url]]
